title: Deezer will soon let you filter out AI-generated music | TechCrunch
summary: Streaming platform Deezer remains steadfast in its intent to help users avoid listening to AI-generated music: The company on Tuesday said it is working on a new toggle that lets users filter out AI-generated music uploaded to its platform.
